cl.x: Provide Sikaplan® WP Protection Sheet-15 HE where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).

cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Description
cl.x: Sikaplan® WP Protection Sheet-15 HE is a homogeneous protective membrane with an embossed surface, based on polyvinylchloride (PVC-p).

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Uses
cl.x: Protection of waterproofing membranes on base of PVC-p, also in combination with injection backup systems.
Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Characteristics / Advantages
s: Embossed surface to allow proper spreading of repair injection material
High resistance to mechanical influences
Without DEHP (DOP) plasticisers
High dimensional stability under permanent pressure and heat
Flexible at cold temperatures
Suitable for contact with acidic soft water and alkaline environments
Resistant to root penetration and micro-organisms
Optimized workability, thermally weldable
Can be installed on damp and even wet substrates
Temporary UV stability for installation

cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Product Information > Storage conditions
cl.x: Rolls must be stored in their original packaging, in a horizontal position and in cool and dry conditions. They must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, etc. Do not stack pallets of rolls during transport or storage.

Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Quality
cl.x: Substrate conditions are as defined for the waterproofing membrane system which is to be protected with the Sikaplan® WP Protection Sheet-15 HE.
Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Product Information
s: Effective thickness: 1.6 (-5 % / +10 %) mm incl. embossing (EN 1849-2)

cl.c: Data sheet pages 2-3: Application Instructions > Application Method / Tools
cl.x: The protective membrane must be fastened by welding to any compatible PVC waterproofing membrane in accordance with the Sika Method Statement for sheet waterproofing membrane installations (available separately on request). The jointing faces must be dry and free from any contaminations.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Important Considerations
s: Installation works must only be carried out by Sika® trained contractors.
The membrane is not UV stabilized and cannot be installed on structures permanently exposed to sunlight and weathering.
The membrane is not resistant to permanent contact with bitumen, and some types of plastics other than PVC or Sika approved system components.

cl.x: Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. Where the data sheet states different limits for the same condition, apply the more restrictive limit and refer to manufacturer. cl.t: Ecology, health and safety - Regulation (ec) no 1907/2006 - reach
cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Ecology, Health And Safety > REGULATION (EC) NO 1907/2006 - REACH
cl.x: This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
